test_case.test_name: FIO QD1 512B 50/50 mixed random SSD validation pending workload authority
test_case.purpose: Measure separately reported read/write IOPS, bandwidth and latency for the authorized 50/50 workload on one disposable SSD target.
required_package: Source-owner approval of randrw+rwmixread=50 versus read-only randread
Exact disposable non-OS target, serial/topology, target extent and raw/filesystem mode
Authorized duration and approved read/write/latency thresholds
Data-loss authorization plus SMART/media/thermal/power abort and reinitialization plan
test_case.test_command: Do not translate or run the source job yet. After workload authority, prove the target is disposable and not OS/boot/mounted/in RAID/in use, capture identity/health, run the approved bounded QD1 512B one-job profile once, preserve fio JSON and device telemetry, then leave reinitialization/remount to the owner.
test_case.expected_result: Authorized workload completes on only the designated target, meets every approved metric and creates no new device/platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative workload semantics and thresholds. Read-only output cannot satisfy 50/50 write coverage, and a numeric result without an approved limit cannot pass.
safety_gate: Block until workload conflict is decided and data loss is authorized.
Fail closed on OS/boot/mount/RAID/open-holder identity checks.
Abort on SMART/media/thermal/power errors; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Workload decision and fio job hash
Target serial/path/topology and negative safety checks
Threshold comparison and owner recovery record
test_case.recovery: If target identity changes, an active holder appears, or the authorized extent is exceeded, stop the one fio process, preserve job/target/health evidence, do not remount or recreate storage automatically, and hand the exact device to the storage owner for inspection and approved reinitialization.
